title: Editors register pending sources without direct knowledge-model access
description:
Feature: Publication-scoped pending source intake
Scenario: Authorized editor registers a source
Given a validated editor of the deployed publication
When a source URL and rationale are submitted through the supported CLI
Then a pending immutable Reference and attributable provenance are returned
And generic knowledge models remain read-only
Scenario: Unauthorized or cross-publication intake
Given an unauthenticated actor or mismatched publication
When intake is requested
Then no data is written
Scenario: Repeated canonical source intake
Given a source already registered
When its canonical URL is submitted again or concurrently
Then the same Reference identity is returned without replacement or duplicate provenance
Scenario: Consulted story evidence
Given a pending registered Reference and existing unpublished Reporting story
When the editor links the returned record as consulted
Then the link is readable and prior story versions and Messages are preserved
